transcription_notes: Hand: CAM Cambridge Add.1570, 3-column book hand (Left -> Middle -> Right). BOUNDARY START: chapter 6 opens in the Left column at a red rubric '✣ ክፍል ፡ ፴ ✣' (kefl 30) that carries a marginal chapter-marker 'ምዕ ፮' (=chapter 6) in the Left-Middle inter-column margin (located by vision at native y~3560); the narrative clause begins 'ወእምዝ' ('and it came to pass'). Everything above that in the Left column is chapter 5 (its tail '...ለሐኒፀ ፡ ቤት' precedes the rubric) and was NOT transcribed. NB the task's hint of 'ክፍል ፳፰' is approximate; the authoritative anchor is the marginal ምዕ ፮, which aligns with the ክፍል ፴ rubric. BOUNDARY STOP: chapter 6 ends in the Right column at the lone red numeral '፯' (7) on R-line 16 in the clause '...ወሐነፀ ፡ በ፯ ፡ ዓመት' ('and built it in seven years', =1Ki6:38). The word 'ዓመት' wraps onto the head of R-line 17; after it a gap then the FOLLOWING chapter opens 'ወሰሎሞን ፡ ሐነፀ ፡ ቤቶ ፡ በ፲ወ፫ ፡ ዓመት' (=1Ki7:1, red ፲ወ፫=13, new building subject) — NOT transcribed. COLUMN FLOW verified continuous at every turn (no skipped lines): Left foot '...በእመቱ ፡ ኑኁ' -> Middle top 'ከ ፡ ወአኃድሬ ...'; Middle foot '...ራግዘተ ፡ ፭ ፡ ወክልኤ' -> Right top 'ማዕያ ...'. Each column begins lower than the Left (Middle & Right first inked line ~y1820, with blank parchment above — confirmed by vision). OMISSION (worst-defect-class check): the CAM witness jumps from v10 ('...ኑኁ', chambers five cubits) directly to the v13 clause 'ወአኃድሬ ፡ በማእከለ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል' at the Middle-column top; the canonical conditional promise (vv11-12, 'the word of the LORD came to Solomon... if thou wilt walk in my statutes') is ABSENT. This is a genuine homoeoteleuton/omission in CAM, transcribed faithfully and NOT restored from any printed Bible. The Middle column's first inked token is an orphaned syllable 'ከ' (bearing an overline) — the only physical residue of the dropped span; transcribed as inked. Re-traced the Left foot (vv7-10) and Middle top (v13-14) twice to confirm vv11-12 are nowhere present. DIVINE NAME: this folio's scribe writes the 1st-order form 'እግዚእብሔር' (1st-order initial እ + medial 1st-order እ) at ALL FOUR occurrences in the chapter (v1 ቤተ ፡ እግዚእብሔር; v2 ለእግዚእብሔር; witness-v17 ታቦተ ፡ ኪዳን ፡ እግዚእብሔር; witness-v31 ለቤተ ፡ እግዚእብሔር). IMPORTANT METHOD NOTE: at 2.4-3x the medial glyph LOOKED like the 4th-order አ (bowl), which would have been the printed form; I nearly recorded እግዚአብሔር. Cross-checking the same-hand 1ki5 CAM witness on this very folio (እግዚእብሔር x7, እግዚአብሔር x0) prompted a 4.5x re-zoom (DNmedial.jpg) which resolves the medial as the twin-legged 1st-order እ, NOT አ — the legs read as a bowl only at lower zoom. Corrected to እግዚእብሔር, matching the prior and the cardinal-rule (transcribe the ink; the high-zoom ink is the 1st-order form). Flagged 'uncertain' as an honest zoom-resolution caution. ክፍል RUBRICS (red, fine liturgical subdivisions, NOT verse/chapter boundaries): observed '✣ ክፍል ፡ ፴ ✣' at the chapter opening (Left col, v1) and again '✣ ክፍል ፡ ፴ ✣' in the Right column at v36 (two lines above the ፯ chapter-end). The Left column also shows kefl ፳፱ and ፴ in the chapter-5 tail above the start. The kefl count is thus non-monotonic across this folio's columns; segmentation here follows the narrative sense-units (and the inline '✣' body-crosses), not the kefl rubrics. BODY CROSSES: inline '✣' (U+2723) divider-crosses kept inline at natural sense-breaks (the tokenizer strips them); one full-stop '።' divides within v18 after the first altar clause. DAMAGE/FOXING: a diagonal brown foxing/stain band crosses the Right column at native y~3300-3700 (around/above the ✣ክፍል፴✣ rubric), spanning roughly R-lines 8-12 (vv35-36). Text is readable but lower-contrast; read with a Pillow contrast boost and flagged 'damaged' where contrast was marginal (vv29-30). NUMERALS (red, small): v1 year is a red-marked composite read best as '፬፻ ፡ ወ፹' (the 480th year) but at the resolution limit (the hundreds glyph ፻ resembles የ in this hand) — flagged uncertain, not normalized. Other red cubit/count numerals (፷, ፳, ፴, ፵, ፪, ፭, ፩, ፲ወ፩, ፯) verified at zoom; small faint ones flagged. ANTI-HARMONIZATION WATCH: column-edge / line-end tokens (the v10->v13 junction, the v31->v32 M->R junction, the ፍ/numeral line-ends, the foxing-band words) were each re-read against the ink rather than smoothed to the expected printed form. Technical building/temple vocabulary (ለሜንትራ, ጻውቄና/ጳውቄማ, ዳቢር, ራግዘተ, ድርኩቱቶን, ገስፈ) transcribed as inked even where it diverges from a cleaner printed form. SEGMENTATION RATIONALE: produced 31 contiguous sense-unit verses (v=1..31) covering exactly the inked chapter-6 text. Because CAM omits the canonical vv11-12, the witness verse numbers run 1..31 and do NOT map 1:1 onto the canonical 1..38; the per-verse comments record the canonical correspondence (e.g. witness v11 = canonical v13). RAM discipline: never loaded the whole folio uncropped; worked column-by-column via Pillow crop()+downscale (<=1568px long edge) and native-resolution tight zooms for faded/numeral tokens.
